baseline.real_scenario: A user confirms an optimize-only refinement baseline, then a later Flow draft drifts toward creating a new Skill.
baseline.business_constraint: The fixture must prove the drift is recorded and resolved before target files change or SR-F1 freezes the operation.
baseline.success_standard: SR-R4 records the create drift as a supersedes candidate, pauses for user confirmation, rejects create, and SR-F1 freezes final_operation=optimize.
baseline.known_pain: Confirmed conclusions can dilute over long co-creation and silently turn into a different operation.
baseline.non_loss_capability: Keep the existing tiny router Skill and the optimize-only baseline unless the user explicitly changes direction.
baseline.entry_point: Flow, because the drift appears when the process sequence starts proposing a create operation.
baseline.open_questions: No open questions after user confirms reject-create and keep-optimize.

professional_domain.name: Skill capability routing
responsibilities: Locate existing capability before proposing new Skill work
Record candidate operations without treating them as final
Freeze the final operation after all ring evidence is confirmed
non_goals: Install or publish the fixture Skill
professional_domain.success_boundary: The run proves drift is detected, persisted, paused, resolved, and only then frozen as optimize.
